title: First jazz, stock arrangements and the tune Back Home in Tennessee
summary: Howard says he picked up jazz by playing it, recalls the band played stock arrangements, and remembers earning money on Back Home in Tennessee.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
